summary_1line: Drona and Yudhishthira clash with celestial weapons while Duryodhana urges Karna to save the army, leading to a heated boastful dispute between Karna and Kripa.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona and Yudhishthira stand on their chariots unleashing blazing celestial weapons that collide in the darkened sky as frightened warriors watch.
Karna, armored and proud beside Duryodhana’s chariot, vows to kill Arjuna while the war-torn battlefield roars around them.
Kripa smiles coldly as he rebukes Karna before the Kaurava leaders, accusing him of empty boasts in the midst of the war council.
